attackers_goals: Exfiltrate sensitive data from the cloud environment.
description: An identity downloaded multiple objects from a bucket, considerably more than usual. This may indicate an attacker's attempt to download sensitive data from a bucket in the cloud environment.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Exfiltration, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check the accessed bucket and objects designation. Verify that the identity did not download any sensitive information that it shouldn't.
